question: A and B can do a piece of work in 36 days. B and C can do the same work in 60 days. A and C can do the same work in 45 days. In how many days can B alone complete the same work?
questionHi: A और B किसी काम को 36 दिनों में कर सकते हैं। B और C उसी काम को 60 दिनों में कर सकते हैं। A और C उसी काम को 45 दिनों में कर सकते हैं। B अकेले उसी काम को कितने दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है?
explanation: Let efficiencies be a, b, c. Then (a+b)=1/36, (b+c)=1/60, (a+c)=1/45. Solving gives b=1/90. Hence B alone takes 90 days.

question: A and B together complete a job in 12.5 days, B and C in 18.75 days, and C and A in 15 days. D is 40% as efficient as C. In how many days will A, B, C and D together complete the job?

explanation: Find C's efficiency from pair equations and add 40% of it for D. Total efficiency = 27/250. Time = 250/27 = 9 7/27 days.
